title.fr: Les rébellions et le gouvernement responsable

text.en: The rebels of 1837–38 failed because not enough of the public supported them. British troops and Canadian volunteers defeated them.
text.fr: Les rebelles de 1837-1838 ont échoué parce que la population ne les appuyait pas assez. Les troupes britanniques et des volontaires canadiens les ont vaincus.

source.quote: the rebels did not have enough public support to succeed. They were defeated by British troops and Canadian volunteers.

verification.evidence: When armed rebellions occurred in 1837–38 in the area outside Montreal and in Toronto, the rebels did not have enough public support to succeed. They were defeated by British troops and Canadian volunteers.

text.en: Responsible government means that the ministers of the Crown can govern only if most of the elected representatives support them.
text.fr: Le gouvernement responsable signifie que les ministres de la Couronne ne peuvent gouverner que si la majorité des représentants élus les appuient.

source.quote: This meant that the ministers of the Crown must have the support of a majority of the elected representatives in order to govern.

verification.evidence: recommended that Upper and Lower Canada be merged and given responsible government. This meant that the ministers of the Crown must have the support of a majority of the elected representatives in order to govern.

text.en: Lord Durham's advice that the Canadiens should assimilate showed that he did not understand French Canadians at all.
text.fr: La recommandation de lord Durham voulant que les Canadiens s'assimilent montrait qu'il ne comprenait pas du tout les Canadiens français.

source.quote: This recommendation demonstrated a complete lack of understanding of French Canadians

verification.evidence: Lord Durham also said that the quickest way for the Canadiens to achieve progress was to assimilate into English-speaking Protestant culture. This recommendation demonstrated a complete lack of understanding of French Canadians

text.en: In 1840, Upper Canada and Lower Canada were joined together as the Province of Canada.
text.fr: En 1840, le Haut-Canada et le Bas-Canada ont été réunis pour former la province du Canada.

source.quote: In 1840, Upper and Lower Canada were united as the Province of Canada.

verification.evidence: In 1840, Upper and Lower Canada were united as the Province of Canada.

text.en: Nova Scotia was the first colony in British North America to win full responsible government, in 1847–48.
text.fr: La Nouvelle-Écosse a été la première colonie de l'Amérique du Nord britannique à obtenir un gouvernement pleinement responsable, en 1847-1848.

source.quote: The first British North American colony to attain full responsible government was Nova Scotia in 1847–48.

verification.evidence: The first British North American colony to attain full responsible government was Nova Scotia in 1847–48.

text.en: Sir Louis-Hippolyte La Fontaine was the first to lead a responsible government in the Canadas.
text.fr: Sir Louis-Hippolyte La Fontaine a été le premier à diriger un gouvernement responsable dans les Canadas.

source.quote: became the first leader of a responsible government in the Canadas.

verification.evidence: Reformers such as Sir Louis-Hippolyte La Fontaine … La Fontaine, a champion of democracy and French language rights, became the first leader of a responsible government in the Canadas.
